title: 第776章 以前的事情2第776章 莉雅与林恩往事
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
几天之后，忙碌无比的各种事情结束之后，林恩与成为圣女莉雅的莉雅撞在一起。
眼前的莉雅仿佛经历了一次彻底的蜕变。曾经萦绕在她眉宇间、举止里的那份怯生生的犹豫与自我怀疑，如同被阳光驱散的晨雾，已然消散无踪。
她身披简约而庄重的圣女袍服，行走间步伐沉稳，目光清澈而坚定，昔日的“拖后腿”气质被一种沉静内敛的力量感所取代。
林恩嘴里正叼着一根棒棒糖，百无聊赖地转着。
瞥见莉雅身影的瞬间，他几乎是条件反射般，以迅雷不及掩耳之势将棒棒糖从嘴里抽出藏起，换上了一根点燃的香烟，动作流畅得仿佛演练过千百遍。
依旧按照系统的话语去走。
这叫做对症下药。
只不过莉雅并非如此，她双手轻轻交叠在身前，步伐平稳地走近。她的目光落在林恩指间那支还未点燃的香烟上，平静地开口：“林恩。”
“你不会抽又在抽了？”
咳咳……”林恩被这直接的询问弄得呛咳了两声，脸上闪过一丝被戳破的懊恼，将烟从唇边拿开，“你怎么知道我不会？”
“从你第一次试图点烟的时候，就看出来了。”莉雅的语气没有什么波澜，既没有厌恶，也没有好奇，只是陈述一个事实。
完了。
林恩心里咯噔一下。在心里大叫道：“完了，成嘉豪了，还是抑郁的豪。”他试图挤出一个笑容，但那笑容怎么看都有点勉强，在如今的莉雅面前，似乎轻易就能被看穿。。
莉雅却似乎并不在意他的窘迫，反而微微弯起唇角，伸出手，指尖泛起柔和的白光，轻轻拂过林恩的脸侧。“圣光·治愈。”温暖的光芒流淌，不仅驱散了他脸上并不存在的疲惫，更有一缕细微的能量精准地没入他颈侧——那里因连日过度处理文书和魔法通讯而有些滞涩的魔力回路，在这纯粹的治愈之力下悄然理顺。
“好了，哼~哼~”她收回手，竟带着一种轻快的调子，像哼着某种简单的小曲。这突如其来的、带着点调皮意味的哼唱，像一根柔软的羽毛，不经意间扫过林恩的尾椎，带来一阵轻微的、令人头皮发麻的酥痒感，让他差点没站稳。
“你好像……有点不一样了？开朗了许多？”林恩稳住身形，敏锐地捕捉到了她的变化。
“嗯？有吗？”莉雅将手背到身后，微微偏头，日光透过高窗洒在她金色的发梢上，“你就当是吧。毕竟，我现在是圣女了呀。”她的声音里带着一种理所当然的轻松，那是卸下重负、找到位置后的坦然。
“所以...”林恩有一些疑惑道，同时在心里疯狂吐槽，等等。
哥们说好的，她不一样呢？
这是因为经典的女性身份认同达成了，没有压力了，开始得意了？

因为当了圣女，身份坐实了，压力没了，开始放飞自我了？
所以，心情好，哼两句也没什么吧？”莉雅的笑意加深了些，目光落在林恩脸上，“而且，也多亏了林恩你呢。”
哦？因为我？
林恩一愣，我做什么了？
还没转过弯来。在他自己的认知里：实力停留在三阶
不算什么顶尖高手；名声在某些圈子里也就那样
没什么光环加持。莉雅本身底子就好，只是缺了点勇气和契机。
他觉得自己无非是在关键节点出现，说了几句大概符合“剧情需要”的鼓励话，扮演了一个类似“引路人”的普通角色。哪来的这种发展啊！
我不接受!
可实际情况根本不是那么回事。
content_en:
A few days later, after all the extremely busy things were over, Linn bumped into Leah, who had become the Saintess Leah.
The Liya in front of her seemed to have undergone a complete transformation. The timid hesitation and self-doubt that once lingered in her brows and demeanor had disappeared like morning fog driven away by the sun.
Wearing a simple and solemn saintly robe, she walks with steady steps and clear and firm eyes. Her former "sluggish" temperament has been replaced by a calm and restrained sense of strength.
Linn was holding a lollipop in his mouth, spinning it around boredly.
The moment he caught a glimpse of Liya, almost as a conditioned reflex, he took the lollipop out of his mouth and hid it with lightning speed, replacing it with a lit cigarette. His movements were as smooth as if he had rehearsed them thousands of times.
Still follow the words of the system.
This is called prescribing the right medicine.
But Liya was not like that. She gently folded her hands in front of her and walked forward steadily. Her eyes fell on the unlit cigarette in Linn's fingers, and she said calmly: "Lynn."
"You don't know how to smoke and you're smoking again?"
Ahem..." Lin En choked twice at the direct question, a hint of annoyance flashed across his face, and he took the cigarette away from his lips, "How do you know I can't? "
“You can see it from the first time you try to light a cigarette. "Liya's tone was calm, neither disgust nor curiosity, just stating a fact.
It's over.
Linn's heart skipped a beat. I shouted in my heart: "It's over, Cheng Jiahao is still a depressed Hao. "He tried to force out a smile, but the smile looked a bit forced. In front of Liya today, it seemed to be easily seen through.
Liya didn't seem to care about his embarrassment. Instead, she slightly curved her lips, stretched out her hand, and gently brushed the side of Lin's face with soft white light on her fingertips. "Holy Light·Healing. "The warm light flowed, not only dispelling the non-existent fatigue on his face, but also a subtle ray of energy accurately penetrated into the side of his neck - the magic circuit there that was somewhat stagnant due to excessive processing of documents and magical communications for days, was quietly straightened out by this pure healing power.
"Okay, hum~hum~" She took back her hand, with a light tone, like humming some simple ditty. This sudden, slightly naughty humming was like a soft feather, inadvertently sweeping across Linn's tailbone, causing a slight, scalp-numbing itch that almost made him lose his balance.
"You seem...a little different? A lot more cheerful? "Lynn stabilized her figure and keenly captured her changes.
"Huh? Is there any? "Liya put her hands behind her back and tilted her head slightly, the sunlight shining through the high window on the tips of her golden hair, "Just take it as such. After all, I am a saint now. "There was a natural ease in her voice, which was the calmness of having relieved one's burden and found one's place.
"So..." Linn said with some doubts, and at the same time complained crazily in his mind, etc.
Buddy agreed, but she is different?
Is this because the classic female identity is achieved, there is no pressure anymore, and you start to feel proud?
Because after becoming a saint, my status is confirmed, the pressure is gone, and I can start to let myself go?
So, if you’re in a good mood, it’s okay to hum a few words, right? "Liya's smile deepened, and her eyes fell on Linn's face, "And, it's all thanks to you, Linn. "
Oh? Because of me?
Linn was stunned, what did I do?
Haven't turned the corner yet. In his own perception: his strength stays at the third level
He is not a top expert; his reputation in some circles is just that.
There is no aura blessing. Liya herself has a good foundation, but she lacks some courage and opportunity.
He felt that he only appeared at key points, said a few words of encouragement that probably met the "needs of the plot", and acted like a "guide"."Ordinary character. Where did this kind of development come from!
I don't accept it!
But the actual situation is simply not the case.
